title: Schools and Colleges in Lahore: Study Options and Official Sources
excerpt: A source-led Lahore education guide covering selected schools and colleges, the study stages they describe, and where families should verify current admissions information.
content:
## How to use this guide

Lahore has a wide range of school and college choices. This guide brings together a small, verified set of institutions from official sources. It is not a ranking. Compare the study stage, location, curriculum information, and current admissions instructions before making a decision.

## Institutions covered

### Aitchison College

Aitchison College describes junior, prep, and senior schools on its official website. Its senior-school information includes Cambridge and FBISE study options. The institution is located in Lahore, and its contact page provides the campus address. Families should use the college's current admissions instructions rather than relying on an older intake date.

### Lahore Grammar School 55 Main

Lahore Grammar School 55 Main identifies junior and senior schooling and describes Cambridge O and A Level study, with academic areas including sciences, humanities, and social sciences. The 55 Main campus is in Gulberg, Lahore. Confirm the relevant campus, age group, entry requirements, and application window directly with the school.

### The City School Pakistan

The City School describes a network serving learners from early years through A Level and provides a campus directory. The network's official site identifies its Lahore head-office address and its wider Pakistan presence. Because campuses can differ, applicants should select the relevant Lahore campus and verify its current programme and admissions details.

## Questions to compare

- Which class or study stage is accepting applications?
- Which curriculum and subjects are offered at the specific campus?
- What are the current fees, deadlines, and required documents?
- Which official contact channel can confirm information that may change?

Use the official institution links below for current admissions, contact, and campus information. STRIDETO does not assign a ranking to these institutions.

## Sources

- [Aitchison College official website](https://aitchison.edu.pk/)
- [Aitchison College contact information](https://aitchison.edu.pk/contact-info)
- [Lahore Grammar School official website](https://lgs.edu.pk/)
- [Lahore Grammar School 55 Main profile](https://lgs.edu.pk/our-school/)
- [The City School Pakistan official website](https://thecityschool.edu.pk/)

title: Schools and Colleges in Karachi: Study Options and Official Sources

content:
## How to use this guide

This guide covers two Karachi institutions using information published by their official websites. It is an orientation resource, not a ranking or a substitute for the institution's current admissions notice.

## Karachi Grammar School

Karachi Grammar School describes early years, junior, middle, and senior sections on its official site. The site identifies the Clifton campus and describes the school community and governance through a Board of Governors. Families should confirm the relevant section, entry process, documents, and dates with the school.

## Nixor College

Nixor College describes itself as an A Level institution and publishes information about academic subjects, admissions resources, and campuses in Clifton and Bahadurabad. Applicants should check which campus and intake apply to them, then use the college's own admissions and contact pages for current requirements.

## Comparison checklist

- Match the institution's section or level to the student's current stage.
- Check whether the published information applies to the intended Karachi campus.
- Verify subjects, entry requirements, fees, deadlines, and required documents from current official notices.
- Use official contact channels when an online page does not answer a time-sensitive question.

Admissions details can change between intakes. Treat the official institution pages as the final reference.

## Sources

- [Karachi Grammar School official website](https://kgs.edu.pk/)
- [Nixor College official profile](https://www.nixorcollege.org/about)
- [Nixor College contact information](https://www.nixorcollege.org/contact)

title: Government College Peshawar: Admission and Study Guide
excerpt: A practical, source-led guide to Government College Peshawar, its official location and study information, and the checks applicants should make before applying.
content:
## What this guide covers

Government College Peshawar is identified by the Higher Education Department of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa as a government college established in 1957. The department's college page provides the strongest source used for this guide. This article does not reproduce a complete prospectus or claim that a particular intake is open.

## Study information

The official college directory lists intermediate and diploma offerings. The available study information should be read alongside the latest official admission notice because programmes, eligibility, dates, and document requirements can change.

## Location and verification

The official listing places the college at Faqeerabad, Hashtnagri, College Chowk, Peshawar City. Applicants should confirm the campus and the current contact process through the Higher Education Department listing or the college's authorised channels before submitting an application.

## Application checklist

- Confirm the current programme and eligibility requirements.
- Check the opening and closing dates in the current official notice.
- Prepare only the documents requested by the authorised admissions channel.
- Keep a copy of the submitted application or receipt where provided.

Use the official authority listing as the starting point for current information. STRIDETO does not infer deadlines or admission outcomes from historical records.

## Sources

- [Higher Education Department Khyber Pakhtunkhwa college listing](https://admission.hed.gkp.pk/college.php?college_id=3)

title: Technical Institutes in Quetta: Training and Study Options
excerpt: A source-led guide to technical and language study options at QITEL in Quetta, with practical checks for comparing courses and verifying current enrolment information.
content:
## How to use this guide

Technical and language training choices should be compared by course content, schedule, entry requirements, recognition, and the support available for the intended learner. This guide uses QITEL's official website as a source and is not a ranking of Quetta institutes.

## Quetta Institute of Information Technology and English Language

QITEL's official site describes computer, English-language, and technical courses. The site states that the institute has operated in Quetta since 2017 and identifies an affiliation with the Trade Testing Board, Balochistan. Prospective students should verify the current course list and the scope of any affiliation directly with the institute or the relevant authority.

## Questions before enrolment

- What is the exact course title, duration, schedule, and entry requirement?
- What practical or assessment component is included?
- What certificate or recognition is issued, and who recognises it?
- What are the current fees, intake dates, and contact arrangements?

Use the official institute source for current information. Do not assume that a course, fee, affiliation, or intake remains unchanged from an earlier publication.

## Sources

- [QITEL official website](https://www.qitel.edu.pk/)
